# Claw, phase 1: one primitive per part at the spec's sizes. Generated by make_claw.py.
new
# cable stub z 0.88..1.10
add mesh cylinder --name Cable --vertices 6 --radius 0.035 --depth 0.22 --location 0 0 0.99
# hub: an octagon 0.50 across its flats, z 0.645..0.84, a chamfer to 0.36 across at z 0.90
add mesh cylinder --name Hub --vertices 8 --radius 0.2706 --depth 0.195 --location 0 0 0.7425 --rotation 0 0 22.5
add mesh cone --name HubTop --vertices 8 --radius1 0.2706 --radius2 0.1948 --depth 0.06 --location 0 0 0.87 --rotation 0 0 22.5
# collar: 0.44 across its flats, z 0.545..0.645
add mesh cylinder --name Collar --vertices 8 --radius 0.2381 --depth 0.10 --location 0 0 0.595 --rotation 0 0 22.5
# prong ProngB: upper bar out and down, lower bar back in, a toe bent inwards; built along +X, turned 90
add mesh cube --name ProngBUp --size 1 --location 0.2900 0.0000 0.4300
scale 0.08 0.09 0.4421
apply --scale
set rotation 0 132.88 0.00
apply --rotation
apply --location
add mesh cube --name ProngBLo --size 1 --location 0.3925 0.0000 0.1750
scale 0.08 0.09 0.3210
apply --scale
set rotation 0 163.30 180.00
apply --rotation
apply --location
add mesh cube --name ProngBToe --size 1 --location 0.3075 0.0000 0.0425
scale 0.07 0.09 0.1262
apply --scale
set rotation 0 98.97 180.00
apply --rotation
apply --location
select ProngBUp ProngBLo ProngBToe
active ProngBUp
join
rename ProngBUp ProngB
set rotation 0 0 90
apply --rotation
